page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head at top, page number at top left. Below the text: centred heading "ANNOTATIONES." followed by one paragraph of commentary in smaller type, full width. No margin notes.

main_text.p: venientis flatus vehemetis patefacta describitur. Exsic cari flumen,& redigi in exiguos torrentes,quos liceat etiā calceatis pertransire,nihil aliud est,quàm amove-ri omnia impedimenta,quæ videbantur posse obstare, quo minus Euangelium quàm latissimè divulgaretur.
main_text.head: CAPUT XII.
main_text.p: Dices autem in die illo: Confitebor tibi Domine, quoniam iratus es mihi: avertatur ira tua,& cōsoleris me. Ecce Deus salus mea,confidam & non pavebo: quoniā fortitudo mea & canticum Dominus Deus, factusq; est mihi in salutem. Haurietis aquas in gaudio de fonti-bus salutis,& dicetis in die illa: Confitemini Domino, invocate in nomine eius: nota facite in populis studia eius: recordamini quòd exaltatū sit nomen eius. Psallite Domino, quoniam magnalia fecit, & hoc divulgatum est per universam terram. Iubila & canta habitatrix Sion, quoniā magnus est in medio tui sanctus Israëlis.
main_text.head: ANNOTATIONES.
main_text.p: Dices autem in die illo.) Hactenus de officijs regis Christi, nunc describentur etiam officia subditorum ad eius regnum pertinentium, ex quibus Euangelij à lege discrimen, praeterea illius præhac dignitas elucescit. Ait ergo propheta ad unum.

page.notes: Long s read as plain s throughout (e.g. "falus" as salus, "Pfallite" as Psallite, "Ifraëlis" as Israëlis). "Exsic" read from a partly blurred long s, possibly Exfic. "exaltatū" and "cōsoleris" carry macron abbreviations as printed. Last word "unum." is in italic and runs over to the next page. The annotation paragraph is set in smaller type below the text and is therefore type="foot". No catchword or signature visible.
